title: Manhattan Tie Cells In Frame
written_solution: Keep the frame and the two seeds. Inside the frame, color every cell whose Manhattan distance to the first seed equals its Manhattan distance to the second seed with maroon(9).
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (let* ((frame (first (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))))
           (bb (obj-bbox frame))
           (fcolor (obj-color frame))
           (seeds (filter (lambda (cell)
                            (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
                              (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v fcolor))
                                   (not (= r 0)) (not (= c 0))
                                   (not (= r (- (rows g) 1))) (not (= c (- (cols g) 1))))))
                          (grid-cells g)))
           (a (first seeds))
           (b (second seeds))
           (with-seeds (paint-cells (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) (obj-cells frame) fcolor)
                                    (list a b))))
      (for*/fold ([out with-seeds])
                 ([r (in-range (+ (first bb) 1) (third bb))]
                  [c (in-range (+ (second bb) 1) (fourth bb))])
        (if (or (and (= r (first a)) (= c (second a)))
                (and (= r (first b)) (= c (second b))))
            out
            (if (= (+ (abs (- r (first a))) (abs (- c (second a))))
                   (+ (abs (- r (first b))) (abs (- c (second b)))))
                (set-cell out r c 9)
                out))))))
